apps.name: Hippocampus
apps.subtitle: Speak a thought, find it again.
apps.localizedDescription: Personal knowledge system fed by voice, structured without losing the original.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Hippocampus reads only the calendars you tick in Settings, so it can bring up what you meant to say shortly before a meeting with the people it concerns. It never changes your calendar.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Hippocampus reads only the calendars you tick in Settings, so it can bring up what you meant to say shortly before a meeting with the people it concerns. It never changes your calendar.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hippocampus records what you say to keep it as a note. It is transcribed on this iPhone, and the recording is kept with the note on your own backend.
